title: Nice looking coverd
text:
Nice looking coverd. These slip covers cover up the damage done by my cat and fading from the sun! It looks like a new chair.
They are a bit difficult to put on and the foot rest part sometimes slips off. I am buying upholstery pins to fasten it down.
I don’t like that there is a pocket where the handle is. When you use the handle to put the recliner back, it pulls on the material. I may try to remove the pocket to lessen the strain on the material.
Otherwise, I am satisfied with the quality and price.
